summary: Defines MatchStrategy and DimensionRole enums, sentinel values, and the CTX_PREFIX constant.

key_classes.name: MatchStrategy
key_classes.summary: Enum of 11 dimension match strategies: EXACT, NOT_EQUAL, RANGE, GREATER_THAN, LESS_THAN, PREFIX, SUFFIX, CONTAINS, REGEX, SET_MEMBERSHIP, SET_EXCLUSION.

key_classes.name: DimensionRole
key_classes.summary: Enum distinguishing CONSTRAINT (lattice filter) from CONTEXT_KEY (partition key) dimensions.

extension_points: Adding a new MatchStrategy enum member is the first step when extending match strategies.
documentation_hooks: Ternary encoding (1/0/-1) is consumed here via sentinels — document the sentinel contract for extension authors.
risks: UNKNOWN_NUMERIC sentinel (-999999999) must not collide with valid domain values. Users with values near INT_MIN should be warned.

evidence.detail: imports UNKNOWN, NOT_SET, STRING_SENTINELS, NUMERIC_SENTINELS, MatchStrategy
